text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With an all-out effort, Twin Turbo 
conquers the Satsuki Sho. It was a run 
that gave 1,000% of her power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this victory, her confidence at 
Nakayama Racecourse grows deeper. Perhaps 
another day will come when she works a 
miracle here once again.
